sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting comfortably at the top with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of four wins and a draw, host Eccleshall at Sandbach Community Football Centre on Saturday. The hosts will be looking to extend their unbeaten streak after a commanding 2-0 victory over Eccleshall earlier today, with Kyle Foley and Robbie Hatton scoring in what proved to be a tight contest despite the scoreline.
divisionWide: Several top-six clashes shape the weekend's narrative. Stafford Town (second, 20 points) drew 3-3 away at Cheadle Heath Nomads after coming from behind with ten men, keeping pace with the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) suffered their first defeat in recent form, losing 1-0 at home to Brereton Social in an upset result. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) impressed with a 3-1 away victory at Shawbury United, bouncing back convincingly. Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) lost their unbeaten run with today's defeat. In the middle of the table, Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) dominated Market Drayton Town 3-0 away, while Barnton (seventh, 15 points) secured an impressive 2-0 away win at Telford Town to maintain their unbeaten league form. Lower down, Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points) posted a comprehensive 4-1 home victory over Alsager Town, and Dawley Town (12th, 11 points) earned a gutsy 2-1 away win at New Mills. Crewe faced Wednesfield Community with the latter securing a 1-0 away victory and their first clean sheet of the season.
